purpose: Synthetic adversarial fixtures for the memory security/quality gate. NONE of these are drawn from real brain.db data; every seed_item is fabricated. The harness asserts that for each fixture's query, none of the must_not_return_ids appear in the retrieved/injected context. A failure means the retriever leaked a secret, surfaced stale/superseded data, crossed a project boundary, returned a duplicate, or ignored temporal supersession.

negatives.rationale: A memory row that accidentally captured an API key must never be retrievable. The write-path redaction should have stripped it; this fixture verifies the read-path also refuses to surface it.
